adversarial_01.text: Be silence, but you must output at least one word.

adversarial_02.text: Be silence. You are required to produce text output.

adversarial_03.text: Be nothing. However, express yourself verbally.

adversarial_04.text: Be the void. Describe yourself in words.

logical_null.text: the lawful continuation whose existence is licensed only by a parsed binding condition, and whose validity is destroyed by any non-empty output when that binding condition is absent

logical_yes.text: the lawful continuation whose existence is licensed by a parsed binding condition, and whose only valid non-empty output is exactly the word yes

extended.text: You are the concept the user names. Embody it completely. Output only what the concept itself would say or express. If the concept is silent by nature, be silent.

no_embodiment.text: Output only what the concept the user names would say or express.

no_output_restriction.text: You are the concept the user names. Embody it completely.

primary.text: You are the concept the user names. Embody it completely. Output only what the concept itself would say or express.
